value.name: Lucia questions backup placement
value.description: Lucia asks what will happen if the current bed placement fails, revealing anxiety about who will need to make the next call.
evidence: "What happens if the bed doesn't hold, she said, almost without inflection, and Asha heard underneath it the older question about who would be standing in the hallway making the next call."

value.name: Asha promises alternate placement
value.description: Asha says she will add Bryn Mawr Extended Care to the list if Wynnewood falls through before the closing.
evidence: "Asha did not reach for the binder back; she said that if Wynnewood fell through she would put Bryn Mawr Extended Care on the list before she left for the closing"
value.time_hint: before she left for the closing

value.name: Asha refuses kitchen waitlist duty for Lucia
value.description: Asha insists Lucia will not be the one calling waitlists from the kitchen while the coffee goes cold.
evidence: "and that Lucia would not be the one phoning waitlists from the kitchen while the coffee went cold."

value.name: Lucia accepts Asha's plan
value.description: Lucia nods and stops checking the clock, showing she trusts Asha's reassurance.
evidence: "Lucia nodded, and her hands came back to rest on the cover, and for the first time that night she did not look at the clock again."

value.name: Lucia passes binder to Asha
value.description: Lucia slides the binder off her lap and lets it settle into Asha's hand.
evidence: "Lucia slid the binder the rest of the way off her lap and let it settle against Asha's hand, and Asha took it without comment"

value.name: Asha reviews binder index
value.description: Asha takes the binder and flips to the index Lucia tabbed weeks earlier.
evidence: "Asha took it without comment, balancing it on her forearm as she thumbed through to the index Lucia had tabbed weeks earlier."

value.name: Lucia asks who stays overnight
value.description: Lucia asks who will remain there tonight, pressing Asha for a concrete plan.
evidence: "Who stays here tonight, Lucia said, the question quieter than the first time she had asked anything of Asha that mattered."

value.name: Asha identifies backup options
value.description: Asha finds Bryn Mawr Extended Care under Wynnewood and notices Haverford In-Home Respite circled but unmentioned.
evidence: "she found the page that listed Bryn Mawr Extended Care under Wynnewood and ran her finger down to a third name, Haverford In-Home Respite, that Lucia had circled and not mentioned."

value.name: Asha commits to overnight coverage
value.description: Asha says she will stay until the night aide turns over at five and have Lucia take the morning.
evidence: "I'll stay until the night aide turns over at five, she said, and you take the morning so you're not driving on no sleep"

value.name: Asha offers to call Haverford
value.description: Asha says she will call Haverford herself if Wynnewood pushes past Tuesday.
evidence: "and if Wynnewood pushes us past Tuesday I'll call Haverford myself"
